_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
12/28 5:49AM - Rise and shine! Today’s shaping up to be yet another stellar day on the slopes of Stratton. For your Sunday you will find 76 ways down across nearly 500 acres of skiable terrain with 55 trails that were smoothed out after last night's groom. 13 lifts are scheduled to spin at 8:30am with no delays anticipated.

East Byrnes Side is scheduled to make its debut today with 6 features including 3 rails, 2 jumps, and a half pipe! Yes, a HALF PIPE! Please note there may be a delayed opening while our park team makes the final cuts on the half pipe. Stay tuned for updates! 

Hopefully those legs aren’t too sore after yesterday’s pow because today’s one of those days you won’t want to miss. Catch you on the slopes!

Safety Tip: Ski and ride with a friend while in the glades. 

The Coca-Cola Tube Park is now open! Reservations are recommended to save your spot while availability lasts. Tubing is available in 50 minute sessions starting at the top of each hour. Book now to secure your tickets! Please read the details and policies prior to purchasing your tickets. Hope to see you there!

Hungry? Luckily for you, Holiday week is in full swing with extended dining hours, live music, and special events keeping the Village looking lively. Check out our Holiday Week Dining, Après & Live Music Guide to see what's open, happening, and where the music is at.

The Holidays have arrived at Stratton! The Village is decorated with lights and the schedule is decked with events. Après heats up with live music at Grizzly's, cozy nights at Paint & Sip, and festive fun rolling all week long into a stacked lineup of New Year’s celebrations. Ring it in your way with family dinners, dancing it out at the Silent Disco, hiking up for a one of a kind fireworks view, or watching the fireworks light up the mountain from the base area. There’s something for everyone this Holiday week and we couldn’t be more excited to celebrate with you! Click here to check out the upcoming Events Calendar.

Want to go on an adventure of a lifetime? Well, you're in luck, our Guided Snowmobile Tours are back! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee it.

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Hooray! Our Christmas weekend storm delivered the goods, bringing 8 inches of new snow to the mountain over the last 24 hours for a 12 inch storm total. A DJ will be spinning outside Moonbeam Lodge to celebrate the recent snowfall. Today we’re expecting partly cloudy skies and temperatures in the teens. Conditions are variable with a mixture of fluff and firm underfoot. Sunrise chairlift is now open, providing access to limited, ungroomed terrain. We are as excited as you for freshies but don’t duck ropes into closed terrain. Unseen hazards exist and you will lose your pass for at least 30 days (at all Ikon Pass resorts). Due to early season conditions, there is no beginner terrain accessible from Moonbeam Express. Apex Express terrain should be considered “experts only.” Please check your speed and be aware of other skiers and riders. Have a great Sunday on the hill!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Laurie with your 5 am snow report for Sunday, December 28th. Remember the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website. 
It’s a powder day in the Boat! At Mid Mountain, we’ve had 12 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 6 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
At the Summit, we’ve had 15 new inches of snow in the past 24 hours, with 10 inches falling since the mountain closed yesterday.  
Our Mid mountain base is 22 inches, the temperature is 8 degrees, the winds are 11 miles per hour from the NW, and it's snowing. 
The Summit base is 34 inches, the temperature is 1 degree, the winds are 25 miles per hour from the W, and it's snowing. 
The base temperature is 17 degrees.  
We will be skiing and riding on 18 lifts, 40 runs, and 296 acres on Powder.  
Introducing The Amble, a new luxury home community steps from Steamboat Square. If you are interested in learning more, Amble on over to our sales center next to the transit center and grab a warm cup of cocoa.  
Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  
If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go.  
Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

12/28 5:00 AM Update: Happy Sunday skiers and riders! We've received nearly a foot of snow in the last couple of days. Groomers and off-piste will be soft and forgiving. Early season obstacles still exist, but they are harder to find. Northway is expected to open today! Come join us for smooth turns and sunshine today.

We have returned to regular access and our standard parking plan. Read the SPECIAL OPERATIONS UPDATE below for more details. 

Notes for today:
  1. Although early season conditions still exist widespread around the mountain, there are pockets of deeper snow. Read up on Tree Well and Snow Immersion Safety before heading out on the slopes, and please take it easy out there, especially in higher traffic areas.
  2. Ski & ride with care. We know you’re excited, and we are too. Please ride responsibly and stay in control today as we launch the 2025-2026 Winter Season. Brush up on Mountain Safety and the Responsibility Code!
  3. Obey all mountain closures. Our team is working hard to open terrain as quickly and safely as possible. Closed areas are closed for a reason, so please keep yourself and our team safe by only skiing in open areas.
  4. As a reminder, when being added from the parking waitlist, cancellations are still required if you're not planning on making it up. Thank you!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
December 28th, 6:20 AM
Good morning skiers and riders, and happy holidays! Today’s shaping up to be pure mountain magic with carving turns, après vibes, and soaking in every ounce of joy these slopes bring. Today's forecast calls for a rise in temperatures, expect mid to high 20's at the base and mid to low 20's at the summit. Look forward to dancing on 40 machine groomed runs, paired with packed powder on natural terrain, expect all conditions to soften throughout the day. Snowmaking has finishing up on Racer's Edge and Lower Snowball, and groomers will be pushing out whales tonight. Cruiser and Riemergasse will also be finishing up with snowmaking and getting a groom, and snowmaking will move to Sugar Run. Saddle up your sleighs, we’re expecting several snowy days during the holiday week, which could bring over 12 inches of fresh snow as we head into the New Year!

We will be getting down on 460 skiable acres served by 12 lifts and 107 open trails. Ropes have dropped on loads of natural terrain, please use caution as coverage is thin and suggested for experts only. Hiking for North Lynx is open from 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM today. Whether you're looking for easy laid-back groomers or leg burning moguls, we've got it all.

Operations are in holiday hours, which means GMX, Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate will get the party started at 8:00 AM. Followed by all other scheduled lifts at 9:00 AM, with the exception of Inverness which will open to the public at 1:00 PM. The Sugarbush Parks crew has assembled a bumping freestyle setup at Mt. Ellen with 15 features and 2 jumps. Plus, Slowpoke at Lincoln Peak is home to 4 features, and newly installed side hits! Parks crew has added a handful of features on Sugarbear Forest as a bonus! Join us Dec 24th - Jan 1st, for our Holiday Week at Sugarbush, filled with skiing, riding, and festive events for the whole family. Check out all of our winter events!

The uphill evening route at Lincoln Peak and Mt. Ellen is open, check out our uphill travel policy for more info. *Lincoln Peak morning route and Cruiser at Mt. Ellen will be closed for up/downhill travel tonight due to grooming*

Bonjour Tremblant!

Milder temperatures are back once again today, setting up a very enjoyable day on the mountain! With calm conditions, a clear sky, and good visibility, this morning is shaping up to be especially nice for first tracks.

Almost all of our skiable terrain is open, offering plenty of variety across the resort. Please note that some runs on the south side will open progressively throughout the morning, so there will be more to explore as the day goes on.

This past week's snowfall and the continued work of our mountain operations team have kept coverage in great shape. Today is a good day to get your laps in and enjoy the conditions, as a weather system moving in tonight may bring freezing rain, which could impact conditions afterward.

It’s a great day to be here. Enjoy the conditions and every run!


Mountain safety tip of the week: Be careful when using the ski lifts.
Knowing how to board ski lifts is essential to ensure the safety of all users. Here are a few tips for a safe experience:

• Familiarize yourself with the lift before using it and pay attention.
• Ask the ski lift attendant if you are unfamiliar with how it works.
• Follow the rules posted along the lift route.
• Watch the chairlift safety video: Vidéo utilisation sécuritaire télésiège
 
Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
